name: openclaw-channels
title: OpenClaw Channels
description: Channel-first chat for your OpenClaw gateway
author: Kris77z

preferences.name: endpoint
preferences.title: API Endpoint
preferences.description: OpenClaw gateway URL. Use http://127.0.0.1:18789 for local, or your Tailscale serve URL (e.g., https://machine-name.tailnet.ts.net) for remote access.

preferences.name: mainKey
preferences.title: Main Session Key
preferences.description: Optional main key override for session keys (default: main)

preferences.name: webUiBaseUrl
preferences.title: Web UI Base URL
preferences.description: Optional UI URL override (official WebUI or LobsterBoard). Defaults to endpoint.

preferences.name: defaultProfileId
preferences.title: Default Profile ID
preferences.description: Default profile id when profilesJson is configured.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
